strings.en:
**The following report collects the content of Project Omega subject Plokk's audio logs, as transcribed by project specialist Keelli, for Overseer Kuda's eyes only. Unauthorized access will be reported and prosecuted according to Inquest compliance protocols.**  
  
*Entry 1*  
Overseer Kuda has requested that we make these logs for documentation purposes after our exposure to the seer magic that powers the forge. I underwent the procedure this morning, and so far I do not feel any discernible difference to my physiology or cognition. When I volunteered for this assignment, I believed my usefulness would begin and end with helping chart the course to Castora, yet now...I have the potential to be remembered for something even greater.  
  
*Entry 2*  
I am beginning to feel it! The strength...the power. My body courses with it, like my skin cannot contain my being any longer! The feeling is intoxicating. I think of the ones who called me "runt" as a progeny... They would not dare to utter such nonsense if they saw me now. They would pay for such impudence with suffering.   
   
Overseer Kuda is a visionary. I owe her and will serve the Inquest under her, with every breath in my body.   
  
*Entry 3*  
My body...has undergone a radical change. I am tall! And so very strong. I didn't realize our people even had such capacity for muscular...I cannot think of the word. How curious. But I have outpaced even Overseer Kuda's projections of my physical response, and she appeared rather pleased. She seems very excited to show me, and the other two lesser specimens, off to Director Vloxx himself! I'm sure he will see the value in expanding the Omega program. Imagine what the Inquest could become with this.
